classification: post-hoc full-factorial alpha-parameter audit around frozen R360; research-only
known_limits: The grid is adjacent, not exhaustive; values outside 3-10 days, 10-30 holding days and -15% to -25% stops are not covered.
Only the realistic 2x cost case is rerun for all 27 cells; 5x remains a centre-point diagnostic.
The current industry snapshot is backfilled and is not point-in-time data.
Historical HS300 membership and ETF adjusted-price limitations remain.
The 27 cells are correlated and are not independent multiple-testing trials.
